title: Live Updates: Scale of Flood Disaster Grows as Nepal Doubles Estimate of Missing
summary_full: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.
